title: Cost of the LCFs' meaning: each side's best in expliCCit's exact network, on held-out links, sharing and alone
description: Does giving the latents a meaning cost a learned congestion controller anything? Both sides use expliCCit's encoder-decoder network exactly: an encoder of 1.27 million weights turns the measurements into seven numbers, and an actor and a critic of two layers of 256 read only those seven. The one difference is what the seven numbers are trained to be. On the meaningful side the encoder is neto1 v1, trained beforehand on ground truth to output the seven LCFs and then fixed; on the free side the encoder starts from random weights and is trained by the decisions' loss, so its seven outputs take whatever form helps. Splitting the network lets the meaningful side train in stages, which the free side cannot, so each side is compared at its best training rather than held to one method. Each side's best was chosen on links 0 to 99 by the mean over training seeds 0 and 1 (exp-lcf-cost-budget-search-342), after every candidate's budget and alpha were extended until the last step gained less than 0.1: meaningful, the actor copying BBRv3 on neto1 v1's seven LCF estimates for 30,000 updates (lcft-paper-none-n30k); free, TD3+BC at alpha 2.5 on log utility with 10-step returns for 300,000 updates (lcftd-free-a2.5-n300k). The free side's other method, encoder and actor copying BBRv3 together for 30,000 updates (lcft-freefix-none-n30k), runs beside it, so the answer does not hang on the free side's choice. All three run on training seeds 0 to 9 (exp-lcf-cost-budget-340, exp-lcf-cost-budget-2-341, exp-lcf-cost-final-seeds-343, exp-lcf-cost-final-seeds-2-344). Also scored, not a candidate since it adds a second 1.23-million-weight network: the larger decision maker on the true LCFs, alpha 1, 150,000 updates (lcftd-deeptruth-a1-n150k), seeds 0 to 4, its configuration chosen in exp-lcf-cost-budget-search-342 (run 339 tested the earlier choice). With BBRv3, in four campaigns of 300 links each: links 100 to 399 of net2's training links (a one-off in distribution) and 300 unseen links, each with competing flows and with the flow alone, every controller on every episode. The procedure was fixed before any held-out score of these choices: the cost is the free best minus the meaningful best, mean log utility per 10 ms step with a 95% bootstrap interval over links, the median difference over seeds, and Mann-Whitney over seed means; a reading holds on at least 3 of the 4 campaigns. metrics-*.json give utilization, queueing delay and loss per controller.
prepare: P=(); for s in $(seq 0 9); do F="$IN/a"; [ "$s" -ge 2 ] && F="$IN/c"; P+=(--policy "split-paper-imit-n30k-s$s=$F/lcft-paper-none-n30k-s$s/policy.onnx"); done; for s in $(seq 0 9); do F="$IN/b"; [ "$s" -ge 2 ] && F="$IN/d"; P+=(--policy "e2e-free-td3-a2.5-n300k-s$s=$F/lcftd-free-a2.5-n300k-s$s/policy.onnx"); done; for s in $(seq 0 9); do F="$IN/a"; [ "$s" -ge 2 ] && F="$IN/c"; P+=(--policy "e2e-free-imit-n30k-s$s=$F/lcft-freefix-none-n30k-s$s/policy.onnx"); done; for s in $(seq 0 4); do F="$IN/a"; [ "$s" -ge 2 ] && F="$IN/c"; P+=(--policy "lcftd-deeptruth-a1-n150k-s$s=$F/lcftd-deeptruth-a1-n150k-s$s/policy.onnx"); done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 70 ]; for x in "${P[@]}"; do [ "$x" = --policy ] || [ -f "${x#*=}" ]; done; uv run python experiments/comfort.py "$OUT/spec-train" --links 100:400 --seed 32 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/comfort.py "$OUT/spec-unseen" --links 0:300 --seed 33 --set net2-train-xl --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/comfort.py "$OUT/spec-train-alone" --links 100:400 --seed 34 --alone --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/comfort.py "$OUT/spec-unseen-alone" --links 0:300 --seed 35 --set net2-train-xl --alone --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; for k in train unseen train-alone unseen-alone; do cmp "$OUT/spec-train/aliases.json" "$OUT/spec-$k/aliases.json"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-$k/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-$k"; done; cp "$OUT/spec-train/aliases.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --over-seeds; uv run python experiments/arm_versus.py "$OUT" e2e-free-td3-a2.5-n300k:split-paper-imit-n30k e2e-free-imit-n30k:split-paper-imit-n30k e2e-free-td3-a2.5-n300k:e2e-free-imit-n30k lcftd-deeptruth-a1-n150k:split-paper-imit-n30k e2e-free-td3-a2.5-n300k:lcftd-deeptruth-a1-n150k split-paper-imit-n30k:bbr3 e2e-free-td3-a2.5-n300k:bbr3 e2e-free-imit-n30k:bbr3 lcftd-deeptruth-a1-n150k:bbr3; { cat "$OUT/versus.md"; echo; cat "$OUT/summary.md"; } > "$OUT/summary.tmp"; mv "$OUT/summary.tmp" "$OUT/summary.md"; for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign summary "$c" > "$OUT/metrics-${c##*/c-}.json"; done
